set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- ReadableArray no longer exposes an internal bridge that types borrowed storage as owned NDArray.
- A private ownership-neutral source exposes only dtype, storage, and layout facts needed by read-only kernels.
- Built-in kernels consume that source without changing numerical or layout semantics.
- Owned, borrowed, and mutable readable inputs can be supported without public ownership erasure.
- No public ownership-neutral implementation type is added accidentally.
- JVM and Scala.js tests, representation proof, and allocation courts remain green.
set.title: Replace ReadableArray.toNDArray with an ownership-neutral kernel source
